edges.reason: setConfig is gated by onlyConfigGovernor comparing msg.sender to governor.config.
delayStartTime is gated by onlyConfigGovernor on msg.sender.
changeFundsGovernor is gated by onlyFundsGovernor on msg.sender.
changeConfigGovernor is gated by onlyConfigGovernor on msg.sender.
changeModulesGovernor is gated by onlyModulesGovernor on msg.sender.
ejectFundsGovernor is gated by onlyFundsGovernor on msg.sender.
ejectModulesGovernor is gated by onlyModulesGovernor on msg.sender.
grant is gated by onlyConfigGovernor on msg.sender.
setModule is gated by onlyModulesGovernor on msg.sender.
setCustomFunction is gated by onlyModulesGovernor on msg.sender.
The payable fallback is callable by any msg.sender and forwards calls to registered targets.
changeFundsGovernor compares msg.sender against governor.funds and writes it.
changeConfigGovernor compares msg.sender against governor.config and writes it.
changeModulesGovernor compares msg.sender against governor.modules and writes it.
The fallback looks up customFunctions[msg.sig] to resolve the forwarding target.
The fallback performs an unbounded external call with msg.value to a governor-controlled target before returning.
_authenticateSender delegates to _isSenderAllowed which inspects msg.sender.
_isSenderAllowed compares msg.sender to the requested user or checks its role.
_isSenderAllowed falls back to _hasRole(msg.sender).
_authenticateSender requires _isSenderAllowed to be true.
_hasRole derives the role id from address(this) and msg.sig and queries controller.hasRole.
hasRole reads the ACL roles mapping including the ANY_ADDR wildcard.
_hasRole calls through the stored controller address.
recoverFunds is gated by onlyFundsGovernor reading controller.getFundsGovernor().
pay passes msg.sender as the depositor (_from) to _deposit.
_payer is used as event metadata in pay.
_token indexes the period share mappings in pay.
_amount is validated and split by pay.
governorShare is derived from _amount via the pct helper.
guardiansShare is derived from _amount minus governorShare.
governorShare is added into periods[periodId].governorShares[_token].
guardiansShare is added into periods[periodId].guardiansShares[_token].
pay uses PctHelpers.pct to compute the governor share.
_getCurrentPeriod returns the periodId used by pay.
_getCurrentPeriod returns the Period storage pointer used by pay.
pay mutates the periods mapping of the current period.
pay calls _deposit to move funds into the contract.
_deposit performs an external ERC20 safeTransferFrom call using the caller supplied token.
_deposit sanity-checks the token address with isContract.
_periodId selects the period and is required to be in the past.
_guardian is authenticated and used to compute the active balance and share.
_tokens is iterated to claim each token share.
claimGuardianShare ensures period balance details before computing shares.
claimGuardianShare checks the guardian has not already claimed each token.
_hasGuardianClaimed reads the claimedGuardians flags of the period.
claimGuardianShare calls _claimGuardianShare to flag and pay each token.
_guardian is the recipient and flag key inside _claimGuardianShare.
The iterated token address flows into _claimGuardianShare.
_claimGuardianShare transfers the computed amount via _transfer.
_transfer sends ETH to an arbitrary recipient through _to.send.
_transfer performs an external ERC20 safeTransfer to the recipient.
claimGovernorShare iterates tokens and calls _claimGovernorShare.
_claimGovernorShare resolves the amount with _getGovernorShare.
_claimGovernorShare transfers the governor amount via _transfer.
The local amount is resolved before transferring in _claimGovernorShare.
ensurePeriodBalanceDetails delegates to the internal checkpoint computation.
The term randomness is stored in the local randomness variable.
The registry total active balance is stored in the period and returned.
_ensurePeriodBalanceDetails falls back to blockhash(getBlockNumber() - 1) when randomness is zero.
The checkpoint is used together with guardian active balance queries.
The period balance checkpoint flows into the guardians registry active balance query.
setGovernorSharePct is config-governor-only and delegates to _setGovernorSharePct.
_setGovernorSharePct validates the permyriad bound and writes governorSharePct.
_getGuardianShare multiplies the token share by the guardian active balance using SafeMath.
claimGuardianShare computes the claimable amount with _getGuardianShare.
pct multiplies by the permyriad value via SafeMath and divides by PCT_BASE.
pct256 uses SafeMath multiplication.
pctIncrease uses SafeMath multiplication for the increased value.
mul multiplies the caller-provided operand _a.
mul multiplies the caller-provided operand _b and checks c / _a == _b.
sub validates _b <= _a to prevent underflow.
add requires c >= _a to detect overflow.
div requires the divisor _b to be greater than zero.
safeTransfer encodes the call and delegates to invokeAndCheckSuccess.
safeTransferFrom delegates the low-level call to invokeAndCheckSuccess.
safeApprove delegates the low-level call to invokeAndCheckSuccess.
invokeAndCheckSuccess performs an assembly call forwarding all gas to the target token.
The assembly success and returndata determine the local ret flag.
invokeAndCheckSuccess returns the assembled ret flag.
recoverFunds sends the whole ETH balance with _to.send to a governor-supplied recipient.
recoverFunds performs an external ERC20 safeTransfer to the recipient.
linkModules iterates the supplied module ids.
linkModules stores the supplied addresses keyed by ids.
linkModules writes linkedModules; it is only callable by the controller.
_syncModuleLinks external-calls IModulesLinker.linkModules on each module address.
setModules loops and calls _setModule for each new module.
setModules syncs links of new and existing modules.
syncModuleLinks delegates to _syncModuleLinks.
setModule delegates to the internal module setter.
_addr flows into setModule and then into _setModule.
_setModule requires isContract(_addr).
_setModule writes currentModules[_id].
_setModule writes allModules[_addr].id.
disableModule sets allModules[_addr].disabled = true.
enableModule sets allModules[_addr].disabled = false.
_isModuleDisabled reads the allModules disabled flag.
_getModuleAddress reads currentModules[_id].
_getModule resolves the address via _getModuleAddress.
_getModule resolves the disabled status via _isModuleDisabled.
grant delegates to _grant after the governor check.
revoke delegates to _revoke after the governor check.
freeze delegates to _freeze after the governor check.
bulk delegates to _bulk after the governor check.
_id flows into grant and then into _grant.
_who flows into grant and then into _grant.
_bulk dispatches Grant operations to _grant.
_bulk dispatches Revoke operations to _revoke.
_bulk dispatches Freeze operations to _freeze.
_grant writes roles[_id][_who] = true.
_revoke writes roles[_id][_who] = false.
_freeze writes roles[_id][FREEZE_FLAG] = true.
isRoleFrozen reads roles[_id][FREEZE_FLAG].
delayStartTime delegates to _delayStartTime.
_newFirstTermStartTime flows into delayStartTime and _delayStartTime.
_newFundsGovernor is validated then stored via _setFundsGovernor.
_newConfigGovernor is validated then stored via _setConfigGovernor.
_newModulesGovernor is validated then stored via _setModulesGovernor.
_delayStartTime requires _currentTermId() == 0 before delaying.
_delayStartTime rewrites terms[0].startTime based on the new start time.
setConfig ensures the current term before applying the config.
setConfig forwards the validated values into _setConfig.
_setConfig updates configChangeTermId to the effective term.
_setConfig appends or overwrites the configs array.
_setConfig writes configIdByTerm[_fromTermId].
_ensureTermConfig copies configIdByTerm from the previous term.
_onTermTransitioned calls _ensureTermConfig for the transitioned term.
_getConfigFor resolves the config id via _getConfigIdFor.
_getConfigIdFor reads the scheduled configChangeTermId.
_getConfigIdFor reads configIdByTerm for the term or the scheduled change term.
_getConfigFor returns configs[id].
ensureCurrentTerm delegates to _ensureCurrentTerm.
_ensureCurrentTerm queries the needed term transitions.
requiredTransitions is computed then bounded by the auto-transition constant.
_ensureCurrentTerm calls _heartbeat with the required transitions.
heartbeat delegates to _heartbeat with the requested transitions.
_maxRequestedTransitions flows into heartbeat and _heartbeat.
_maxRequestedTransitions bounds the number of executed transitions.
transitions is the minimum between the requested and needed transitions.
currentTermId is incremented inside the transition loop.
previousTermId captures the term id before the loop.
_heartbeat assigns termId = currentTermId after the loop.
The new term start time is computed from previousTerm.startTime + termDuration.
_heartbeat writes startTime and randomnessBN of each transitioned term.
_heartbeat reads the current block number to seed term randomness.
_heartbeat invokes the overridable _onTermTransitioned hook for each transition.
_neededTermTransitions depends on block.timestamp through getTimestamp64.
getTimestamp64 wraps getTimestamp which returns block.timestamp.
getTimestamp returns the miner-influenceable block.timestamp.
block.timestamp indirectly drives the number of pending term transitions.
block.timestamp flows through getTimestamp64.
getBlockNumber64 converts getBlockNumber() output.
getBlockNumber64 uses the checked uint64 downcast.
_computeTermRandomness requires getBlockNumber64() > term.randomnessBN.
_computeTermRandomness reads terms[_termId].randomnessBN for blockhash.
ensureCurrentTermRandomness computes and stores the term randomness.
ensureCurrentTermRandomness writes terms[currentTermId].randomness.
_currentTermId adds the needed transitions to termId.
_currentTermId reads and increments the ensured termId.
_getCurrentPeriodId divides the term offset by periodDuration.
_getPeriodStartTermId multiplies the period id by periodDuration.
_configGovernor calls controller.getConfigGovernor().
_clock casts the stored controller.
_courtConfig casts the stored controller.
_getLinkedModule reads linkedModules[_id] and requires non-zero.
_ensurePeriodBalanceDetails requests the term randomness from the clock.
Both claim functions enforce that the period is strictly in the past.
ensurePeriodBalanceDetails requires the period id to be lower than the current period.
claimGuardianShare requires the claimed period to be in the past.
claimGovernorShare requires the claimed period to be in the past.
The fallback reads customFunctions[msg.sig] to resolve a target.
_isModuleDisabled reads allModules[_addr].disabled.
Role checks are ultimately resolved against the Controller owning the ACL.
_ensureModuleExists requires the module id stored in allModules to be non-zero.
toUint8 validates the uint256 operand before truncation.
toUint64 validates the uint256 operand before truncation.

normalization_plan.reason: _newFirstTermStartTime exists only to parameterize delayStartTime and its internal delay routine.
_newFundsGovernor is the sole input of changeFundsGovernor.
_newConfigGovernor is the sole input of changeConfigGovernor.
_newModulesGovernor is the sole input of changeModulesGovernor.
_addr parameterizes setModule/disableModule/enableModule module management.
_id identifies the role granted by grant.
_who is the role recipient in grant.
_token indexes payments by token inside pay.
_amount is the paid value validated and split inside pay.
_payer is only used as event metadata in pay.
_periodId selects the claimed period in the claim flow.
_guardian is the authenticated beneficiary of claimGuardianShare.
_tokens is the token list iterated by the claim flow.
_maxRequestedTransitions caps the transitions executed by heartbeat.
_ids are the module ids linked by linkModules.
_addresses are the module addresses linked by linkModules.
_a is the first operand of the SafeMath arithmetic primitives.
_b is the second operand of the SafeMath arithmetic primitives.
periodId is derived and consumed entirely inside pay.
The Period storage pointer is used only within pay.
governorShare is computed and accumulated within pay.
guardiansShare is computed and accumulated within pay.
transitions bounds the loop executed inside _heartbeat.
currentTermId is mutated only inside the _heartbeat loop.
previousTermId is captured only inside _heartbeat.
requiredTransitions is computed and checked only in _ensureCurrentTerm.
amount is resolved and transferred only in _claimGovernorShare.
ret is assembled by the assembly block and returned by invokeAndCheckSuccess.
randomness is used only to pick the balance checkpoint in _ensurePeriodBalanceDetails.
totalActiveBalance is stored and returned only by _ensurePeriodBalanceDetails.
